title: Twisted Metal: Black

rules.evidence: ps2x::native::setGsFrontEndAbsent in tmb_native.cpp: no GS object, no GS memory, no GS packet read in the default mode (TMB_NATIVE=0 is the diagnostic path)
no setGsFrontEndAbsent: the GS front end is constructed
PS2X_NATIVE_AUDIO=1 by default (tmb_overrides.cpp): libsd's exports go to the fork's native mixer, the SPU2 is never scheduled (TMB_NATIVE_AUDIO=0 brings it back)
libsd runs on the emulated SPU2
PS2X_IOP_HARDWARE=0 by default (tmb_overrides.cpp): the registers a module's start code touches are plain storage; TMB_IOP_HARDWARE=1 brings the models back
the recompiled IOP modules still run on the fork's IOP kernel layer (interrupts, timers, SIF): TMB's README lists it as in progress
native frames by default (timer1HandlerNative, setNativeFrames): frames on the PC clock; TMB_NATIVE_FRAMES=0 is the diagnostic
frames end on the emulated vblank

blind_spots: TMB's native VU programs are matched by the microcode they replace at run time (tmb_native.cpp, runtime/vu1): they are not listed as VU program squares.
